_comment: MARIMBA bar type (bar TYPE 1 of firmware/src/bars.c, panel TYPE MARIMBA): the physics data tools/gen_bars.py builds the tables from (MARIMBA PLAN §5). The VIBES schema (gen_bars.check_vibes): every T-row has src and status (CONFIRMED / CORRECTED / DERIVED / MEASURED-REF / ESTIMATE), every ESTIMATE a settle entry. No samples and no recordings: the numbers are papers, physics derivations, the FE / contact / pair tools of the tree and listening (D10 = no). Sources: ISMA = Beaton & Scavone ISMA 2019 (bar measurements); BEATON = Beaton PhD 2022; SERRA = Serra et al. (marimba C4 analysis); RUCZ = Rucz et al. JASA (mallet-bar contact); SDA23 = Soares et al. JSV 2023 (bar-tube coupling); D98 = Doutaut et al. 1998; LHS = the Malletech resonator notes; LAFAVRE = La Favre's marimba resonator tables; E-VAL / D-VAL / F-VAL = the VIBES research validations (private/vibraphone).

keys._doc: every MIDI key 21..108 plays its own pitch; C2..C7 (5 octaves, a concert marimba) is authentic, outside extrapolated (the FE of the end bar) and flagged (bar_key_t.flags bit0)

T12._doc: bar outline and material: through the anchor bar (piecewise: L and w geometric in semitones C2 - anchor - C7, the thickness linear C2 25 mm - anchor 22 mm - C7 22 mm); the undercut profile tuned by tools/bar_fe.py (isotropic Timoshenko with the rosewood E along the grain, G the shear modulus; h_min the thinnest the cut may go)

anchor._doc: ISMA Table 1: seven F#3 bars 373-423 x 51-58 x 22-26 mm, 331-447 g (the FE's F#3 mass must fall in it, Gate VA-M12)

T12.src: ISMA Table 1 (anchor); BEATON Table 3.1 p. 45 (rosewood after Bork 1999: rho 1080, E_x 23.0 GPa, G 3.0 GPa); the C2 / C7 outline ESTIMATE
T12.settle: a published dimension table or a measured instrument (the user, a tape measure)

T9a._doc: tuned ratios: V2 = 4 f0, V3 = 10 f0 by the undercut up to v3_tuned_max_key; above, the FE tunes V2 only and V3 is the profile's own ratio (reported)
T9a.src: ISMA §4 ('consistently very near 4'); SERRA C4 1 : 4.00 : 9.39; BEATON 1:4.01:10.08

T11._doc: per-key detune of the upper bending modes (cents re the tuned / FE ratio), drawn uniformly per key (gen_bars.hash01, seed)
T11.src: ISMA §4-5 (V2 within a few cents, V3 'greater variability'); SERRA 9.39 (V3 flat)
T11.settle: listening pack C (no measured per-key ratios: D10 = no)

T10._doc: V4: the FE's own ratio (untuned, 16.8-17.1 x on a 1:4:10 rosewood bar); present wherever it lies under 18 kHz (mode_coefs)
T10.src: the FE of the undercut bar (tools/bar_fe.py)

T9b._doc: torsion T1, T2 per key from the FE (Saint-Venant on the undercut profile); the expected ratios at the anchor are the FE validation (VA-M12)
T9b.src: BEATON Fig. 4.4 (T1 between V1 and V2, T2 near V3 from E3 to B3); LAFAVRE C2 T2 598 Hz

T9c._doc: torsion level: T1 slot peak re V1 in the first 20 ms at TONE +63 (the edge), DEFAULT mallet, v100
T9c.src: VIBES T9c (the user asked for an audible edge); RUCZ §IV.C (torsion only off the centreline)

T9d._doc: torsion T60 = the Rayleigh law at the torsion frequency x mult

T15._doc: slot X: the lateral-torsional partner near 10 f0 (ISMA: on 6 of 7 F#3 bars), off by default; gen_bars --partner renders the A/B (V3 x (1 + u), u per key in ratio_pct, level re V3)
T15.settle: D9: the user's ear (pack C A/B)

T2r._doc: bar damping, Rayleigh: zeta(f) = (alpha / omega + beta omega) / 2, sigma = alpha / 2 + beta omega^2 / 2 (1/s, amplitude e^-sigma t), T60 = 6.908 / sigma, for every bending and torsion mode at its own frequency; alpha x the per-register multiplier alpha_reg (semitone interpolation, 1.0 = the law as measured). The law is a two-parameter fit to F#3 bars on foam supports (BEATON App. A): its alpha term is not physics, so the register settle is by ear within the brackets of T1b; RUCZ's Orff F4 bar (zeta 0.10 %) bounds the multiplier from below
T2r.settle: listening pack A per register (the T1b brackets are the hard limits)

cap._doc: no bar mode rings longer than t60_max_s (a sanity cap; the law gives at most ~1 s)

T1b._doc: V1 with the tube (BELL 64): the solver's targets per register (semitone interpolation of log T60; outside C2..C7 the Rayleigh trend of the bare bar anchored at the end key, never longer than the bare bar above C4) and the practitioner brackets VA-M2 holds the model to. Below C4 the tube LENGTHENS the note (zeta_r < zeta_n: the strongly coupled pair decays at their mean, SDA23); above C4 it shortens it (the vibraphone's weak regime)
T1b.src: the Rayleigh law + the tube (MARIMBA PLAN §2.2-2.3); LHS p. 25 (low notes 1-2 s tuned); Roper (2 s low, 1/50 s to inaudibility at the top)
T1b._doc_2026_10_19: 36 1.6 (was 1.7: the two normal modes within 15 % below C4, VA-M3, need the coupling near critical), 48 1.35 (the TUBE card lengthens C3 by x1.3, VA-M9), 60 0.88 (the weak clamp and the split limit hold C4 near 0.88)

T3m._doc: no damper: key-up mutes by hand with weight MUTE / 127 (MUTE = the DECAY page's K2, P_RELEASE): the drel words are the hand stop (V1 T60 v1_s, upper modes x upper_mult), crossfaded over ramp_sub sub-blocks (the hand's arrival); MUTE 0 = rings out; the pedal holds (w 0); All Notes Off mutes fully. No knock, no felt noise; tube_s: the tube slot's mute T60 (its drel word): the low tubes, strongly coupled, hold +10..16 dB over the bar at key-up and would ring 1.5-3 s on their own after the bar is stopped (the plan's MUTE 127 = 60 dB in 0.12 s needs the radiated note stopped: the hand over the bar also covers the tube's mouth)
T3m.src: MARIMBA PLAN §3.4 (a hand stops a bar in a few tens of ms)
T3m.settle: listening pack D (MUTE 127 on short notes: a hand stop in ~0.1 s)
T3m._doc_2026_10_19: v1_s 0.06, tube_s 0.06 (was 0.08 and none): 60 dB down within 0.12 s of key-up including the 40 ms crossfade (VA-M8)

T4a._doc: tube damping derived per key: zeta_r = alpha_vt c / omega (visco-thermal, alpha_vt = coef sqrt(f) / a, a the inner radius) + (k a)^2 / (2 pi) (radiation from the open end), x fold_mult below fold_below_key (folded / J tubes), bounded [floor_pct, hi_pct]; the inner diameters per register (step: the last row at or below the key)
T4a.src: E-VAL #37 (the formula reproduces SDA23 Table 2); LAFAVRE via E-VAL #31-32 (OD 2.5 / 2.25 / 2.0 in, 1/16 in wall; low tubes ~100 / 76 mm); the fold ESTIMATE

T4b._doc: tube detune (cents re f0, semitone interpolation): the low tubes in tune (a 5-8 c sharp tube splits the strongly coupled low pair by the detune itself and beats at 0.2-0.6 Hz: build/marimba/e2.py), progressively sharp from C4 up, +50 c at C7; below C2 (extrapolated keys) flat, so the V1-like slot stays above 27.5 Hz where rh_coef's cr fits int32 (not more: the integer pair's kc, VIBES lesson 9f25209; above C6 the tube is a reflector and the detune is inaudible)
T4b.src: LHS p. 24-25 ('slightly sharp, more than a half step at the top', qualitative); E-VAL V9
T4b.settle: listening pack B (C2 with a detuned tube)

T5a._doc: coupling sigma per key solved for T1b in [lo, hi] on whichever side the V1 T60 moves (bartube.solve_sigma2), two limits: where zeta_r > zeta_n the weak-regime clamp (s_max sigma <= weak_margin (zeta_r - zeta_n): no splitting at BELL's top); where zeta_r < zeta_n the split limit (the two normal modes at BELL 64 no more than split_max_hz apart: past the critical coupling the pair splits by ~sigma f0 and the note beats); the split limit is split_max_hz past the tube's detune (the detune alone splits the pair), in the weak regime the larger of it and the weak clamp
T5a.src: MARIMBA PLAN §2.3 (E1), §3.8; SDA23 eq. 41 (strong coupling: both modes at (zeta_r + zeta_n) / 2)
T5a._doc_grid: grid_decay_tol: the integer pair's normal-mode decays within this of the continuous design over the stability grid (VIBES 0.02). Near zeta_r = zeta_n (F#3..C5) the two modes have near-equal decays and the discrete coupling's correction kc, fitted at DECAY 64, misses by up to ~5 % at DECAY 127 (a T60 5 % off at RING 127): the plan's 2 % is out of reach there without a per-DECAY kc

T5b._doc: tube radiation weight: the tube part db over the bar's direct f0 at t_s (BELL 64), at most wt_max (the top keys' tube is a reflector: the ratio at 0.2 s, when the note is gone, would ask for a huge weight); bloom_ms_targets: the f0-band envelope's peak (vib_ref_measure's procedure) per register, +-30 % (VA-M4)
T5b.src: VIBES T5b; D98 Figs 9-10 (order of magnitude); t_peak = ln(sigma_t / sigma_b) / (sigma_t - sigma_b)
T5b._doc_2026_10_19: db 16 (VIBES 10): at +10 dB the bar's direct f0 at the strike is as strong as the tube's build-up and the radiated f0 band peaks at 0 ms on every key (no bloom); a marimba bar radiates little at f0 (the tube carries it). The radiated peak saturates near 170 ms at C2 however large wt (the bar's own early f0): C2's target is 180 (the formula's 250-325 ms is the tube's own peak); from C5 up the weak regime's tube is a reflector (peak <= 15-20 ms)

T6._doc: no motor on a marimba: has_motor 0 (bars.c parks the discs, CC 47-51 stored but inert); no damper (T3m) makes RING (DECAY) scale the tube slot's held decay too (bars.c: the tube slot at bar_k_decay on a no-damper type): below C4 the strongly coupled pair decays at the mean of bar and tube, so RING on the bar alone moved C2 by x1.3 only

T6c._doc: the closed-disc residual (unused: no motor), kept for the type record's mot_gc

T7a._doc: contact law F = K d^p while compressed, re-contact allowed (tools/hammer.py)

T7b._doc: effective mallet mass (g) at WEIGHT 0 / 64 / 127 (head 15-33 g x head_factor 1.2); level_comp: the V1 level change with mass taken back by that power (VIBES T7b)
T7b.src: RUCZ Table V (25-35 g, SIM); E:2 ('marimba mallets lighter' unverified)
T7b.settle: listening pack C and the WEIGHT card gate (>= 2.5 LU, centroid >= 5 %)
T7b._doc_2026_10_19: m_g 12 / 26 / 55 g (was 18 / 26 / 40), level_comp 0 (VIBES 0.6): the WEIGHT card must move the level >= 2.5 LU and the attack centroid >= 5 % (the VIBES lesson ad02564) also where T7f caps the contact (C5 up: the mass then changes the force alone); a light head 12 g is a light yarn mallet (10-15 g heads, practice), 55 g a heavy bass mallet

T7c._doc: mallet families (BAR_NFAM order, the shared MALLET detents 0 / 42 / 64 / 85 / 127). K in N/m^p; tau_ms_1ms: K solved for that contact time at 1 m/s on a rigid wall with M_eff = T7b m_g[1]; tc_window_ms: the contact-time check over v8..v127. All yarn laws p 2 (the stiffening wrap), RUBBER p 1.5; the windows of adjacent families do not overlap at equal velocity. calib: the law the generator calibrates with (= the DEFAULT family)
T7c.src: RUCZ 0.7 ms at K 5e7 (SIM); DC94 0.16 ms hard (MEAS); E-VAL V7; the VIBES bunching lesson (d3e61f1)
T7c.settle: listening pack C (no measured yarn force law: E:5)
T7c._doc_2026_10_19: SOFT YARN 4.4, MED YARN 2.5, DEFAULT 1.4 and HARD YARN 0.8 ms (were 3.5 / 2.0 / 1.2 / 0.7): a geometric spacing ~1.75, so every pair of detents is >= 3 dB apart at v100 / v117 / v127 on C3 / C4 (VA-M9; at the plan's spacing SOFT-MED, MED-DEFAULT and HARD-RUBBER came within 2.0-2.7 dB on C3); the windows follow (T8 v_lo 0.17: Hertz tau ~ v^-1/3 for p 2), ordered between neighbours at equal velocity (VA-M5)

T7d._doc: the generic contact-time ranges (ms) over v1..127; each family's own check is its tc_window_ms

T7e._doc: half-sine pulse spectrum: -6 dB at f tau = 0.82, -11 dB at 1.05, first null 1.5

T7f._doc: the pulse's main lobe never longer than f_tau_max / f0 (played faster where capped)

T7g._doc: velocity's own contact scale (v / v100)^-vel_exp on top of Hertz (a harder strike stiffens the yarn)

T8._doc: mallet speed over velocity: v_lo (v1) .. v_hi (v127), geometric
T8._doc_2026_10_19: v_lo 0.17 (was 0.3): the f0 level follows the impulse (m v), so the velocity range is 20 log(v_hi / v_lo) plus the brightness: 0.3 gave 21 dB, the plan asks 26-32 (VA-M10)

T13a._doc: strike position over TONE raw 0..127 (STRIKE): raw 0 -> x = x_dull L (V2 null, the centre), raw 64 -> x_bal L on the centreline, raw 127 -> x_bal L at y = y_edge W off-axis (torsion); x kept node_margin L from the V1 node
T13a.src: HA (L/10, L/3, L/2); RUCZ (torsion ~ the off-axis offset)

T13b._doc: contact noise: SERRA's 2-biquad fit (pole pairs over zero pairs), the level over NOISE 1..127 (dB re full scale), gone by gone_ms (VA-M7: <= -80 dB re the note at 100 ms)
T13b.src: SERRA p. 259-261 (marimba, MEAS fit); VIBES T13b
T13b.settle: listening pack D (the tick at NOISE 127)
T13b._doc_2026_10_19: lvl_db [-87, -31] (VIBES [-60, -24]): NOISE 64 = -50 dB re the note's peak on C4 (VA-M7) and NOISE 127 a clear tick, its 60 ms RMS within 35 dB of the note's (the host test of the C engine; a [-77, -41] span left NOISE 127 43 dB under)

R1._doc: radiation: b ~ (f / f0)^exp / omega per mode (gen_bars bphys)

R1b._doc: radiation trims of V2, V3, V4 PER KEY: the generator puts each slot's onset peak re V1's (the slots' max |x| over window_s, after the contact; the DEFAULT mallet, v100, the default cards) on these lines (dB, semitone interpolation). No measured level table exists (D10 = no): the lines are the pulse spectrum of a medium mallet (f tau) with the upper modes' weaker radiation, flat-ish for V2 and falling with key. Per key because one constant per mode cannot hold the Rayleigh law's register spread: with VIBES's one constant V4 (17.5 f0) came out 20 dB over V1 on every key
R1b.src: MARIMBA PLAN §5 R1b (EST from the pulse spectrum)
R1b._doc_2026_10_19_p4: V2 at key 36 -12 (was -10): the plan's low-register thud (PLAN §2.4, scan M7: C2-E2 with SOFT / MED, V2 <= -10 dB re V1 at the onset, 5..100 ms of the output) read -8.7 dB with MED on C2, golden and C alike: this line is the bar slot's peak, while the output's f0 band at the onset is still short of the tube's build-up (the bloom), so -10 here was ~-8.7 there
R1b._doc_smooth: the trim follows the median over +-smooth_keys keys (the trend; a key whose mode sits near a node of the strike point stays weak), bounded to trim_db in total: attenuation only (a radiation efficiency under the R1 law): where the DEFAULT mallet's pulse rolls a mode off under its line, lifting it made a hard mallet's V3 / V4 30 dB over V1 (RUBBER's pulse is 30 dB flatter at 5 kHz)
R1b._doc_point: each mode measured at its own loudest strike point (the band table BAR_POS argmax, TONE raw on that point): the line is the mode's most at any STRIKE value, so no STRIKE setting lifts it over (at TONE 64 V3 sits near a node, and a trim made there put V3 24 dB over V1 at TONE 16 with RUBBER)

prune._doc: a slot whose loudest single strike (every voicing of the grid, v127, the first t_s after t0_s) stays under db re V1 is never lit (b = 0); presence by physics only, never by a detection floor

calib._doc: as VIBES: the per-key gain to v100 RMS gain_target_dbfs, then each key's v100 loudness (K-weighted, lufs_t) on the STAGE 77 golden render's curve (+-lufs_smooth_keys) + st77_offset_db (provisional: the P5 jack session sets it with its session id), the velocity / family trim iterations
calib._doc_level_t_s: the velocity / family trim measures RMS over 0..0.3 s (VIBES 50..300 ms): a hard mallet's energy on the marimba is in its upper modes, gone by 50 ms (RUBBER v127 came out 8 LU over DEFAULT v127 with VIBES's window)
calib.src: VIBES calib; D11 (start at VIBES's +2.5 dB)
calib.settle: the P5 jack session (hil_jack: SNR_A within 1 dB of ST77)
calib._doc_lufs_t: the per-key loudness match on BS.1770 momentary loudness (0..0.4 s), VIBES 0..1 s: a 0.1-0.3 s note (C6-C7) averaged over 1 s needs 4-10 dB more gain for the same heard loudness, and that gain went into the single-strike peak ceiling

card_level._doc: as VIBES: TONE / BELL level compensation spans, the per-voice peak ceiling over the voicing grid

ring_ceiling._doc: the single-strike ceiling over RING (DECAY) too (gen_bars.ring_ceiling): RING scales the strongly coupled tube's decay (key flag bit3), and the bloom's peak grows with it (C3 +9 dB at RING 127); per key and RING point (point p = RING 8p, the last 127) from from_point (9: RING 72) up, the worst v127 strike over this grid, turned down by its excess over peak_ceiling_dbfs - margin_db (BAR_RINGG, key flag bit4; the gain between two points is interpolated); RING 64 and under untouched
ring_ceiling.src: MARIMBA PLAN VA-M10 (the single-strike ceiling at every grid corner); bar_scan S2 corners (DECAY 127)

card_level._doc_family_ceiling: before the per-key ceiling (gen_bars.fam_ceiling): a family over peak_ceiling_dbfs by more than the DEFAULT family is turned down by the difference on that key; the DEFAULT's own excess turns the key down as a roll-off at most ceiling_slope_db per key (VA-M10 holds the level to ST77 + offset + this roll-off). A wooden bar's short note is far peakier at equal loudness (D11): the roll-off and the offset are the user's to judge (listening, the jack session)

fam_map._doc: MALLET (KN_FAM, MARIMBA's own row; VIBES keeps the linear map) re-spaced between the detents so no key's level jumps (gen_bars.shape_kn_fam): per segment the golden model's loudness (K-weighted over t_s) at npt fractions, every key of keys x vels, default cards; each raw value gets the fraction where the largest per-key change so far (plus floor_db spread evenly, so a flat segment stays linear) is its share of the segment's. The family ceiling turns HARD / RUBBER down by up to 12 dB on C4..A4, and the linear map put most of that drop just past the detent (RUBBER's faster pulse rate: the level follows amp / rate): 1.5..1.7 dB per 4-raw step on G3..E4 at the HARD -> RUBBER knee (PLAN 10.2 B4: <= 1.5 dB including the family knees). The detents are exact, so every render at 0 / 42 / 64 / 85 / 127 is unchanged
fam_map.src: MARIMBA PLAN 10.2 B4 (the S10 lesson 89e18a8); bar_scan S10 steps BARK

type_rec._doc: bar_type_t: budget (upper modes), sleep_rel, tors_q15, nbody, drive_row, flags (no motor, no damper), the BELL map's top (tube size at TUBE 127; VIBES 1.45)

bands._doc: position bands (BAR_POS / BAR_POSG / BAR_TUBEG rows of this type, nband, 612 B each) and the pulse shapes: runs of consecutive position bands share one shape within pulse_tol_db (gen_bars.share_pulses: a VIBES pulse band when one is within it, no flash; else a key of its own, appended, 5280 B each). The plan's 0.45 dB (the VIBES bands' tolerance) is out of reach: the marimba's own shapes need 24 bands for 0.76 dB, 17 for 1.3 dB (build/marimba/pg.py); the VIBES shapes stand for the marimba's only within 1-11 dB (other contact laws: no family is the same). pulse_tol_db trades flash against the attack's evenness, which VA-M / M2 measure
bands.src: MARIMBA PLAN §3.2 (E2: rosewood vs aluminium contacts within 2 %); build/marimba/pg.py
bands.settle: the flash budget (the user) and listening pack C (the attack across the keyboard)
bands._doc_pins: first_key / rep: the position bands gen_bars.assign_bands found (pinned: pinned_bands, never split for this type); pulse_runs: [first band, last band, V (a VIBES pulse band) / K (a key's own, appended), index] as share_pulses solved them (pinned; test_marimba_calib checks each is the solve within 1e-6 dB)
